item.title: A big HFMD season in APAC
item.description: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) seldom makes headlines. The 2026 Asia-Pacific season deserves a closer look anyway. Several countries in APAC are running an unusually large year, with a mix of enterovirus types circulating. As of the end of June this year, Vietnam had recorded 57,599 cases and 10 deaths, a 96.7% increase on the same period in 2025. China logged 538,675 cases over the same six months, roughly double the 263,696 reported in the first half of 2025.
